semantics: Labels opens a Product Labels or Lot/SN Labels choice.
Lot/SN Labels then choose One per lot/SN or One per unit.
Lot/SN output supports 4 x 12 or ZPL Labels and confirms a report action.

implementation: The existing page/API pair remains joined by page.id: transfer-detail.
The Labels server form now supports Lot/SN Labels, per-lot/per-unit quantity, and 4x12/ZPL output.
Tracked lot lines are durable, company-scoped, and seeded from the traceable lot fixture.
Label runs and timeline messages persist the selected label mode and output.
